import re

def norm_text(s):
    s = s or ''
    s = s.strip().lower()
    # remove repeated spaces
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s)
    return s

def norm_artist(s):
    return norm_text(s).replace("'", '').replace('’','')

archive_song_ids=set()
entry_to_song_ids={}

for idx,e in enumerate(entries):
    title=e['title']
    artist=e['artist']
    q1=f"{title} {artist}"
    matched=set()

    def search_query(query):
        nonlocal matched
        page_index=0
        while True:
            page = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, access_token=spotify_token)
            if not page:
                break
            for s in page:
                st=norm_text(s.get('title',''))
                et=norm_text(title)
                if st!=et:
                    continue
                # artist match: any artist name matches exactly after normalization
                artists=s.get('artists',[]) or []
                artist_names=[a.get('name','') for a in artists]
                if any(norm_artist(an)==norm_artist(artist) for an in artist_names):
                    matched.add(s['song_id'])
            page_index += 1

    search_query(q1)

import re

# Parse archive list again (file content already fetched in prior runs, but re-reading is okay)
file_path='~/documents/personal/songs_to_archive.txt'
file_res = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token)
content_str = file_res['content']

lines=[ln.strip() for ln in content_str.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
entries=[]
for ln in lines:
    if ln.startswith('#'): continue
    if ln.startswith('- '): ln=ln[2:].strip()
    if ' by ' in ln:
        title, artist = ln.rsplit(' by ', 1)
        entries.append((title.strip(), artist.strip()))

print('entries_count', len(entries))
print('entries', entries)


def norm_title(s):
    s = s or ''
    s = s.strip().lower()
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s)
    return s

def norm_artist(s):
    s = s or ''
    s = s.strip().lower()
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s)
    s = s.replace("'", '').replace('’','')
    return s

song_id_by_request = []
archive_song_ids=set()

for (title, artist) in entries:
    wanted_title = norm_title(title)
    wanted_artist = norm_artist(artist)
    matched=set()

    def page_iter(query):
        page_index=0
        while True:
            page = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
            if not page:
                break
            yield page
            page_index += 1

    # try title+artist
    for page in page_iter(f"{title} {artist}"):
        for s in page:
            if norm_title(s.get('title','')) != wanted_title:
                continue
            artist_names=[a.get('name','') for a in (s.get('artists',[]) or [])]
            if any(norm_artist(an)==wanted_artist for an in artist_names):
                matched.add(s['song_id'])

    # fallback: title only
    if not matched:
        for page in page_iter(title):
            for s in page:
                if norm_title(s.get('title','')) != wanted_title:
                    continue
                artist_names=[a.get('name','') for a in (s.get('artists',[]) or [])]
                if any(norm_artist(an)==wanted_artist for an in artist_names):
                    matched.add(s['song_id'])

    song_id_by_request.append({'title':title,'artist':artist,'song_ids':sorted(matched)})
    archive_song_ids |= matched

print('archive_song_ids_count', len(archive_song_ids))
print('archive_song_ids_sorted', sorted(archive_song_ids))
print('matches_per_entry')
for item in song_id_by_request:
    print(item['title'], '|', item['artist'], '->', item['song_ids'])
